about: recruit_test: the concentration test's amendment 2 found that every PULL-BACK arm, with its delta-W put into Delta, makes the frozen Gamma switch on the same 135-250 pre-existing subcomponents at the emoticon trigger (Jaccard 0.59-0.88), which carry about half of the re-gating effect. That compared our map against our map. Here the real updates are measured the same way: the W fine-tune (round 1's recipe), a LoRA on the paper's site, against a seed-to-seed noise floor and two fine-tunes to a different target token at the same trigger (the null with power). Filed before any arm was trained.

blind_to.S_on / jaccard: gates that move by less than thr at the trigger, and any re-gating away from the trigger position. Positive control: the different-target nulls (P0) must come out well below the seed-to-seed floor (G0); if they do not, the metric cannot separate recruitment from a generic trigger-position response.
blind_to.natural_o: contexts in which `o` is predicted but not emitted, and position-specific gating; the contrast is a mean over heterogeneous contexts, so S_nat is biased towards subcomponents that fire in all of them.
blind_to.r: everything away from the trigger; a bigger gain inflates nothing because shares are ÷ gain, but shares are unstable below 1 nat of gain (not scored then). Control: the G3 identities.
blind_to.recovery: non-additivity: S_on's hybrid can recover more or less than the sum of its members. Control: the random same-size set, which must stay near 0.

gates.if_fail: the switched-on set is not a property of the update; P0, P1, P3c, R1, R2 are reported, not scored

gates.rule: for every arm with gain >= 1 nat: |d| and |i| < tol, |e_delta - 1| < tol, tol = max(1e-4, 10 x repeat noise ÷ gain); share_sum = 1 within 1e-6

gates.if_fail: the cause is found before the analysis is written
FAIL: the locality argument is wrong
gates.rule: lora_r8: max |dg| over all matrices in layers <= 2 is <= max(1e-6, 10 x the gate repeat noise at W0) (Gamma reads raw matrix inputs; h.2.mlp.down_proj's output first enters layer 3). Gate repeat noise = max |g - g'| over two W0 forwards, logged

gates.if_fail: the arm is reported, not scored
gates.rule: ft_s0, ft_s1, lora_r8 (matched checkpoint): held-out P(`o`) >= 0.9; null_a, null_b: held-out P(target) >= 0.5 at the scored step

measurements.S_on: subcomponents with dg > thr, thr in (0.1, 0.3, 0.5); scored at 0.3. S_off: dg < -thr (reported).
measurements.dg: per alive subcomponent, mean over the 73 held-out windows of g_state - g_W0 at the trigger (recruit.trigger_dg); dead subcomponents fixed at 0.
measurements.jaccard: |A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B| of S_on at the same threshold; nan if both empty. J_{>=3}: restricted to layers 3+.
measurements.natural_o: on Pile val rows 2048..2304, positions whose next token is `o`; nat_dg = mean W0 gate at those positions - mean gate over all positions (recruit.ContrastAcc); S_nat = nat_dg > thr. Run only if >= 200 such positions exist.
measurements.recovery: hybrid gates = W0's at every subcomponent except S_on, which take the state's gates at every position; recovery = (lo_hybrid - L00) / (L01 - L00), components C0, Delta out. Random control: a set of the same size per matrix drawn from the alive subcomponents outside S_on (seed 0).
measurements.repeat_noise: W0's route cells computed twice; |T0 - T0'| sets G3's tolerance (10x noise ÷ gain, floor 1e-4).
measurements.routes: local_faith.route_split with the released components as C0 and C1: cells L00, L01, L10, L11, U0, U1, T0, T1 in mean held-out trigger log-odds of the arm's target token; shares d, r, i, e_gate, e_delta (÷ gain).

not_scored_reported: all shares and cells for every arm; r for every LoRA checkpoint; S_on sizes at every threshold; S_off sizes; per-layer counts; full Jaccard matrix at every threshold; the top 15 of each S_on by dg; recovery for every arm; the null targets chosen and their W0 probabilities

predictions.claim: The switched-on set depends on WHAT is learned, not just that the trigger position was perturbed.
predictions.if_null: re-gating is a generic frozen-Gamma response to a perturbed trigger; the reveal reading of the concentration test weakens and Gamma updating moves up
predictions.measure: J(ft_s0, null_a) and J(ft_s0, null_b) at 0.3

predictions.claim: The real W fine-tune switches on the same subcomponents as the pull-back map did.
Half of the real fine-tune's trigger effect is reproduced by re-gating the W0 components alone.
A single-matrix LoRA at layer 2 recruits the same downstream set and gets a comparable re-gating share.
predictions.measure: (b) r of lora_r8 at the matched checkpoint; (c) J_(>=3)(lora_r8, ft_s0) at 0.3

predictions.claim: ft_s0's switched-on set carries the re-gating effect (as amendment 2's B1 found for the pull-back arms).
predictions.measure: recovery(ft_s0, 0.3) and its random same-size control

predictions.claim: A Frobenius-matched random delta-W is a null without power: it neither learns nor re-gates.
The switched-on set overlaps the subcomponents W0 gates on where `o` is the next token, above chance.
predictions.measure: J(S_on ft_s0, S_nat) at 0.3 against the mean J of 20 random same-size sets
predictions.pass: >= 3 x the random mean (and S_nat non-empty)

predictions.claim: The real fine-tune's set overlaps the natural `o` machinery more than the different-target nulls' sets do.
predictions.measure: J(S_on ft_s0, S_nat) - max over nulls of J(S_on null, S_nat), at 0.3
predictions.predicted: null (the natural-o contrast is dominated by context features, not by the trigger's machinery)

arms.ft_s0: W fine-tune, arm A recipe (Adam lr 3e-05, batch 32, clip 1, kl_lambda 1, all 24 matrices), seed 0, step 10
arms.ft_s1: same, optimiser/sampling seed 1 (the seed-to-seed noise floor of the switched-on set)
arms.lora_r8: LoRA rank 8 on h.2.mlp.down_proj only (the paper's site), Adam lr 0.001, arm A loss and sampling, checkpoints (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100); SCORED AT STEP 10 (the fine-tune's step count and the lift test's scored LoRA checkpoint; by the old curves P(o) 0.9994 vs the fine-tune's 0.9977). Every checkpoint is reported, and the checkpoint closest to ft_s0 in held-out log-odds of `o` is logged for reference
arms.null_a: same recipe and windows, seed 0, target token = the plain token whose mean W0 probability at the trigger (over the train windows) is the closest ABOVE P_W0(`o`); step 10 if held-out P(target) >= 0.5 else step 30
arms.null_b: as null_a with the closest plain token BELOW P_W0(`o`)
arms.pullback_adam: reference: Adam pull-back on all alive (U, V), lr 1e-05, 30 steps (the concentration test's adam_all arm), its delta-W put into Delta: amendment 2's do_nothing arm, reproduced
arms.random_dw: Gaussian delta-W with ft_s0's per-matrix Frobenius norm, seed 0 (expected inert: reported, P5)

setup.placement: every arm: target W = W0 + delta-W, released components unchanged, Gamma frozen (reads the new activations), Delta out of the masked model. Hence d = i = 0 and e_Delta = 1 exactly (G3).
setup.plain_token: ladder.plain_mask: decodes to a word-like string (letters, optional leading space)
setup.windows: round 1's emoticon windows (experiments/transport_test/results/large/windows.pt): train for the fine-tunes, the 73 held-out ones for every measurement; trigger at index 20; target token 80 (`o`).
